lines.trans: This is simply some kind of real holiday!
Chef, why are you smiling so joyfully?
Everything is turning out even better than our plans.
Have you already solved the problem with the stove?
The stove will return to the kitchen on time, Lyova.
Do not say later that I do not listen.
I am simply worried about the evening service.
Tonight our restaurant will make a fortune.
All right, chef, I will get back to work.
Go and supervise the hot kitchen section.
I will do everything in the best way, chef.
Now that is the right and cheerful attitude.
